problem: Let $A$ be a $3\times 3$ matrix with the characteristic polynomial $p(\lambda )={\lambda }^{3}-{\lambda }^{2}+3\lambda -16.$ Then, ${A}^{3}=$
worked_solution:
Using the Cayley-Hamilton theorem, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}p(A) & =O \\ {A}^{3}-{A}^{2}+3A-16I & =O \\ {A}^{3} & ={A}^{2}-3A+16I.\end{aligned}
$$
